operator: Empresa de Transporte Coletivo Grande Marília Ltda (JP Sikansi) / AMTU Marília
notes:
Bus-only city (no metro/rail/tram/ferry), so all routes route_type=3. Operator: the AMTU association manages the network; the concessionaire is Empresa de Transporte Coletivo Grande Marília Ltda (JP Sikansi group). Source of route list + itineraries + schedule times: onibus.online (empresa page listed 31 lines "Horários atualizados 2026"; individual line pages give ordered street itineraries and full weekday/Sat/Sun departure times). AMTU official site (amtumarilia.com.br/horarios-linhas) loads schedules via JS and could not be scraped; Moovit line pages (481 stop points) also returned empty HTML to the fetcher. Stops: itineraries on onibus.online are given as ordered STREET names, not discrete named stop points, so I built 9 evidenced anchor stops (terminals, malls, university, major avenues, neighborhoods) with real OSM/Nominatim WGS-84 coordinates (verified in-bbox for Marília, ~-22.18..-22.25 / -49.89..-49.97). No stops were invented — every stop_lat/lon is a geocoded real place. OSM Overpass (highway=bus_stop) was attempted for the full ~481/1272 stop set but all Overpass mirrors were down/500/504 during the build; Nominatim public endpoint was 429-rate-limited for direct curl but reachable via WebFetch, which is how the anchors were geocoded.

FEED CONTENT: agency; 9 stops; all 31 routes (0001-0080); 256 trips; 636 stop_times; calendar (WEEKDAY/SATURDAY/SUNDAY). For 9 routes I had detailed itineraries+times (L0001,0002,0003,0007,0011,0016,0026,0035,0080) — these use REAL published clock times sampled across the service day, both directions, with 3-stop ordered itineraries anchored at their true endpoints (terminal ↔ neighborhood); L0001 also has real Saturday+Sunday timetables. The other 22 routes (list-only, no scraped detail) get a representative Terminal↔Sampaio-Vidal trip per direction at 06:00/12:00/18:00 weekday as placeholders so every route is valid — these are the low-confidence part.

CONFIDENCE 0.42: route inventory (31 lines, names, numbers) is faithful and current; the 9 detailed routes have realistic real departure times but coarse 3-stop geometry (street-level ordering collapsed to geocoded anchors, not the full stop chain); inter-stop travel times are synthetic (8-min even spacing); 22 routes have only placeholder trips. Feed is structurally valid GTFS (all FK references resolve, every route has ≥1 trip per direction, HH:MM:SS times, calendar covers all service days) but is a skeleton, not a stop-accurate reproduction. To raise confidence: pull the Moovit 481-stop points + OSM bus_stop nodes (Overpass) once reachable and map each street itinerary onto the real ordered stop chain, and scrape the remaining 22 line pages for their timetables.
